card.name: Third digit inside 15th-century years
card.fires_on: The third digit of a four-digit year in the 1400s, such as the 2 in 1421, written after '14'. It also fires on a digit partway through other numbers such as page or citation numbers.

modes.label: Years in the 1400s
modes.description: A single digit after '14' in a year of the 15th century, in history text about rulers or church figures.
